subject: AWS Marketplace launch - product page copy & co-sell assets
messages:
From: Emma Clarke <emma@northwind.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: AWS Marketplace launch: co-sell assets & product page copy

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at Northwind is excited to list our data platform on AWS Marketplace and explore a co-sell motion with Redwood. We have a tight launch window for late May and need help finalizing the product page copy, buyer-facing claim language, and the field enablement scripts for the co-sell team.

Specific asks: 
- Review the current one-liner and benefit bullets for accuracy and compliance (see attached draft).
- Confirm required AMI/AMI metadata and SKU mapping so our infra team can prep the image.
- Provide a short field-scripting doc (30–60s demo pitches + handling common objections).

Can we get a rough timeline and who on your side will own each piece? I can share our internal marketplace checklist if helpful.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m sync if that speeds things up.

Best,
Emma
Product & Partnerships
Northwind Analytics

Attachment: nw_marketplace_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@northwind.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace launch: co-sell assets & product page copy

Emma — thanks for the note and congrats on the decision to list. Looping in Karthik (product copy lead), Marissa (go-to-market / seller enablement), and Jonas (partner ops) to coordinate.

High-level plan (proposed):
1) Copy pass: Karthik to propose concise one-liner + 3 benefit bullets by EOD 4/2.
2) AMI/sku checklist: Jonas to confirm AMI labels and required metadata by 4/6 to give your infra lead time for image prep.
3) Field scripts & playbook: Marissa will draft a 1-pager with 3 demo hooks + objection responses by 4/8; we'll iterate with your SDR/AE partner.
4) Compliance/evidence: we'll validate trust claims and provide suggested evidence snippets (SLA, data handling).

Proposed next step: 30-minute alignment call tomorrow 4/2 at 10am PT — are you available? I attached our internal playbook template so you can see the deliverable format.

Thanks — I'll shepherd this on Redwood's side.

—Kimberly
Head of Marketplace GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachment: playbook-draft-v3.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T14:40:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace launch: co-sell assets & product page copy

Thanks Kim — quick copy pass and notes below. I kept the buyer voice tight for the marketplace tile (short) and expanded bullets for the listing detail page. Also flagged a couple of legal claims that need supporting evidence.

Proposed marketplace tile (one-liner):
Northwind Analytics — production-grade, low-latency analytics on demand (optimized for inference pipelines).

Top 3 benefit bullets (short):
• Deploy in minutes with an AMI pre-configured for inference workloads.
• Predictable per-hour pricing and autoscaling for bursty model evaluation.
• Built-in KV-caching and prefix caching for lower token costs on repeat queries.

Expanded bullets for detail page (examples):
- Production-ready serving runtime: GPU-optimized kernels for Transformer inference with configurable batching and KV cache controls to meet latency SLOs.
- Unified deployment options: Hosted API, Dedicated pools, and Private VPC deployments for regulated data.
- Cost controls: Intelligent batching, quantization recommendations, and per-token analytics to manage unit economics.

Callouts / legal flags:
- "Predictable per-hour pricing" — remove if you can't commit to a per-hour SLA in the public listing; better: "predictable price tiers with committed capacity options."
- Any SLA / uptime claims should be backed by our standard SLA doc or a marketplace-specific addendum.

AMI / metadata notes for Jonas: please ensure the AMI image includes a documented checksum, seller-id, and a minimal startup script that writes instance metadata (region, SKU) to /etc/nw_marketplace_meta. Also confirm the root device type (gp3) and EBS snapshot references for the ami-asset-list.csv.

I'll draft microcopy for the feature callouts and share by tomorrow morning.

—Karthik
Senior Product Writer, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@northwind.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, AWS Partner PM <marketplace@aws-partner.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T16:28:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace launch: co-sell assets & product page copy

Emma — thanks for the quick turnaround from your side and for sharing the draft. Next steps and owners below:

Deliverables & owners
- Marketplace tile + detail-page microcopy (Karthik) — draft for your review by 2027-04-03 11:00 PT.
- AMI metadata + CSV (Jonas) — will send ami-asset-list.csv and checksum details by 2027-04-06.
- Field scripts (Marissa) — 1-pager with 3x demo hooks + objection-handling scripts by 2027-04-08.
- Compliance note (Kimberly) — suggested evidence snippets and trust claims for listing by 2027-04-05.

Links & approvals
- Shared playbook draft: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/marketplace/NW-4392/playbook-v3
- Quick approval link (DocuSign) for the co-sell opt-in: https://app.docusign.com/link/XYZ-Approval-NW4392

Attachments included for your review: field-scripts.md (text/markdown), ami-asset-list.csv (text/csv). Please review the marketplace tile language Karthik will share and flag any compliance wording your legal team requires.

Would be great to lock the tile and seller-facing bullets by 4/7 so we can submit the marketplace listing for review and begin co-sell partner onboarding in mid-April. Can you confirm the 4/2 10am PT call? If that time doesn't work, propose a slot and we'll adjust.

Thanks — excited to get this over the line.

—Kimberly
Head of Marketplace GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachments: field-scripts.md (text/markdown), ami-asset-list.csv (text/csv)
